event_chain.summary: Bridge upgrade sets operator vote weight to zero
White hat MEV bot withdraws ~$10M, later returned

summary: On August 6, 2024 a Ronin bridge contract upgrade mistakenly left the operators' totalWeight (and so minimumVoteWeight) at zero, letting anyone withdraw funds without valid signatures. An MEV bot run by a white hat withdrew about $10-12 million before malicious actors could, and returned the funds; Ronin let the white hat keep a $500,000 bounty.
